title: The sign on the gate
logline: The mill's name on its gate sign, 1994, drawn as a shape of letters with the letters' insides left white — the page won't letter the mill either. The chain-link, the stack, the spotting.

panels.composition: A painted sign on a chain-link mill gate, its letters drawn as outlined shapes left white inside, the yard and smoking stack beyond, black spotting on the gravel.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a painted sign on a chain-link mill gate with its letters drawn only as white outlined shapes, a mill yard and smoking stack beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
